name: bodyweight single leg kas glute bridge
description: A one-leg glute bridge with the knee kept forward. Works each glute on its own and tests hip balance.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot flat and the other leg lifted.
Keep your standing shin close to vertical.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips until in line with your torso.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.
